reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program
    Jurisdiction: New York
    Focus year: 2021

    NOTE: The provided "Natural Language Statutes" are NY Gen Mun L  753 (2021),
    which concerns publication requirements for proposed joint consolidation agreements.
    It does not address landlord-tenant evictions, writs, or stays to pay rent.

    This program encodes:
      (1) The statute text as deterministic obligations; and
      (2) The question scenario as facts; and
      (3) A reasoning layer that answers whether the statutes grant the tenant the right requested.
*/

% -----------------------------
% Statute encoding (NY Gen Mun L  753 (2021))
% -----------------------------

/* NY Gen Mun L  753 (2021) - Publication of proposed joint consolidation agreement.
   Trigger: no later than five business days after commencement of consolidation proceedings
   pursuant to  752, the governing body/bodies shall:
     1) display a copy and summary in a public place(s) for inspection;
     2) display on a website maintained by each entity or other relevant website;
     3) publish a descriptive summary at least once each week for four successive weeks
        in a newspaper of general circulation within each entity.
*/

% Deterministic "deadline" rule: the statute imposes a 5-business-day deadline from commencement.
statute_gml_753_deadline_business_days(2021, new_york, 5).

% Deterministic "publication frequency" rule: once each week for four successive weeks.
statute_gml_753_newspaper_requirement(2021, new_york, once_each_week, 4).

% Deterministic obligation enumeration under  753.
% We treat "governing body or bodies of the local government entities to be consolidated" as Actor.
statute_gml_753_obligation(2021, new_york, display_public_place_copy_and_summary).
statute_gml_753_obligation(2021, new_york, display_on_website_copy_summary_and_reference).
statute_gml_753_obligation(2021, new_york, publish_newspaper_summary_once_weekly_four_weeks).

/* A consolidated, deterministic predicate describing all duties together, so that the statute
   is queryable as a single structured requirement. */
statute_gml_753_requires(Year, State, DeadlineBusinessDays, NewspaperFrequency, NewspaperWeeks, Duties) :-
    Year = 2021,
    State = new_york,
    statute_gml_753_deadline_business_days(Year, State, DeadlineBusinessDays),
    statute_gml_753_newspaper_requirement(Year, State, NewspaperFrequency, NewspaperWeeks),
    Duties = [
        display_public_place_copy_and_summary,
        display_on_website_copy_summary_and_reference,
        publish_newspaper_summary_once_weekly_four_weeks
    ],
    !.

% -----------------------------
% Scenario encoding (facts from the question)
% -----------------------------

scenario_state(new_york).
scenario_focus_year(2021).

scenario_tenant(tenant1).
scenario_eviction_case(case1).
scenario_case_involves_tenant(case1, tenant1).

% The tenant is asking whether they can request a stay of issuance of a writ to have more time to pay rent.
scenario_writ_issuance_at_issue(case1).
scenario_tenant_requests_stay_to_pay_rent(tenant1, case1).

% Helper predicate that succeeds when the scenario is satisfied.
scenario_statement :-
    scenario_state(new_york),
    scenario_focus_year(2021),
    scenario_tenant(Tenant),
    scenario_eviction_case(Case),
    scenario_case_involves_tenant(Case, Tenant),
    scenario_writ_issuance_at_issue(Case),
    scenario_tenant_requests_stay_to_pay_rent(Tenant, Case),
    !.

% -----------------------------
% Reasoning layer: connect statute -> rights relevant to the question
% -----------------------------

% The statute domain in question is municipal consolidation publication, not landlord-tenant procedure.
statute_domain(2021, new_york, gml_753, municipal_consolidation_publication) :- !.

% If a statute's domain is not landlord-tenant eviction procedure, it does not create a tenant right
% to request a stay of a writ to pay rent (for purposes of this program's limited statute set).
statute_can_create_tenant_writ_stay_right(Year, State, StatuteId) :-
    statute_domain(Year, State, StatuteId, landlord_tenant_eviction_procedure),
    !.

statute_can_create_tenant_writ_stay_right(_Year, _State, _StatuteId) :-
    fail.

% A tenant has the right to request the stay only if some encoded statute can create that right.
legal_right_tenant_request_stay_to_pay_rent(Year, State) :-
    statute_can_create_tenant_writ_stay_right(Year, State, gml_753),
    !.

legal_right_tenant_request_stay_to_pay_rent(_Year, _State) :-
    fail.

% -----------------------------
% Final answer predicate (deterministic)
% -----------------------------

housing_answer(yes) :-
    scenario_statement,
    scenario_focus_year(Year),
    scenario_state(State),
    legal_right_tenant_request_stay_to_pay_rent(Year, State),
    !.

housing_answer(no) :-
    scenario_statement,
    !.

% -----------------------------
% Main entrypoint
% -----------------------------

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: Can a tenant request that the issuance of a writ be stayed so that they have more time to pay rent?
